title: RAD Community Mod
description: Contract for mods/<product>/<author>/<mod_name>/mod.yml. Canonical and edited here in the community-mods repo (single-consumer standard — not vendored from dev-docs like the cross-product BOM schema). Enforced by mod-lint. There is no license field — license is fixed by the root LICENSE path-map (CERN-OHL-S hardware, MPL software).

title.description: Human-readable mod name shown on the gallery card.

author.description: GitHub username; must match the author folder name.

product.description: Which RAD product this mod targets; must match the product folder.

description.description: Short description shown on the gallery card.

compatibility.description: Models / firmware revisions actually tested. Do not list untested ones.

images.description: Paths (relative to mod.yml) to images shipped with the mod; each must exist.

source_url.description: Set ONLY for an external/linked mod whose files live in the author's own repo. Its presence makes this an index entry (files are not hosted here) and requires the 'license' field.

license.description: ONLY allowed (and required) for external/linked mods (when source_url is set): the upstream SPDX license id, e.g. CC-BY-SA-4.0. Hosted mods must omit this — their license is fixed by the root LICENSE path-map.

safety.description: Required safety disclosure. Intimate-device mods touching these areas get a human safety review.

notes.description: Describe any safety-relevant behavior, or '–' if none.
